name: Brett Beoubay
biography: Brett Beoubay is a professionally certified and multi-award-winning safety engineer, responsible for the workplace safety & health of more than 70,000 state government employees. Born and raised in New Orleans, La., he graduated Summa Cum Laude from Jesuit High School, after which he moved to Baton Rouge to attend LSU and receive his Bachelor of Science degree in Occupational Safety and Health. His start in the entertainment industry came at an early age as a children’s clothing model, followed by numerous theater performances. In the past 20 years, this SAG-eligible and Best Supporting Actor nominee has appeared in more than 70 film, TV, stage, web, and commercial productions, including an international spot for NETGEAR that won multiple Golden Addy Awards. His credits also include voice-over projects for radio, animation, and JC Penney as well as appearances in print media and at industrial trade shows.
